thread:
Alex K: quick async standup - rollout slice is at 5% traffic now. what I did: wired up metric export for request queue depth + latency percentiles; smoke tested fallback path. blockers: seeing a small bump in tail latency for model-v2 on long prompts (80+ tokens). can people look at traces?
Maria S: looking now — seeing spikes pinned to a few hosts in us-west-2, might be GPU contention. adding node IDs to the trace links.
Jasper T: pinged infra team to check node-level contention. I pushed a hotfix to routing to prefer lower-loaded nodes for the slice. will deploy canary of that fix in 10m.
OpsBot: deploy initiated by @jasper at 1775012400. rollout strategy: subset -> slice -> full depending on metrics.
Linda P: heads-up on feature flag: rollout-traffic-slice is enabled for 5% user cohorts only. flag state: enabled, pinned cohorts: internal+beta.
Sam (product): any user-visible impact? product haven't seen errors, only slight latency for long prompts in logs. still acceptable?
Alex K: no user errors logged, only latency. threshold for rollback is 2% error or 1s increase in p95 sustained for 3min. current p95 delta is ~220ms on affected nodes.
Maria S: I attached trace snippets: ```
trace_id: t-0a1b2c
node: gpu-17
span: kv-cache-lookup
duration_ms: 340
```
Jasper T: thanks — that's larger than expected for that span. i'm going to toggle aggressive prefetch off as a quick mitigation. deploying now.
OpsBot: config rollout started at 1775012512 for routing.preload=false on affected pool.
Linda P: notif to CS and oncall sent. CS will monitor for user reports.
Sam (product): can we get a quick perf dashboard snapshot in channel once the config change lands? need to confirm product ok.
Alex K: will post p95/p99 and request/sec in ~5m after steady-state.
Maria S: follow-up: if latency doesn't improve we should consider draining the two noisy nodes and replace them. Jasper, can infra prepare node drain playbook?
Jasper T: on it. prepping a one-liner to cordon and drain. will share once tested.
OpsBot: reminder - if rollback triggered, automated flag revert will run: rollout-traffic-slice -> false.
Alex K: thanks team. quick asks: @maria please confirm post-change metrics; @jasper share drain one-liner; @linda keep CS posted. I'll update thread with dashboard after 5m. :thumbsup:
Maria S: metrics look better after preload toggle — p95 down ~180ms from peak, p99 unchanged. still monitoring.
Alex K: posted dashboard snapshot: https://dash.redwood/internal/rollouts/1775012345 (internal only)
Jasper T: drain command tested: `kubectl cordon gpu-17 && kubectl drain gpu-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — prepping runbook entry now.
Linda P: CS acknowledged. keeping this in watch for next 30m. will escalate if any user tickets.
Alex K: closing action items: monitor 30m, infra ready to drain if needed, rollback threshold unchanged. will update on final outcome. :white_check_mark:
